steps.title: Stop rules
steps.reason: Google distributes Search, YouTube and other consumer products. Advertisers pay to reach users through these products. Cloud customers pay for infrastructure, software and AI services. Alphabet also funds autonomous transportation and other early-stage businesses. Shared AI research and infrastructure require substantial capital. Interest coverage and cash support near-term financial resilience, but Debt/EBITDA is not testable because complete D&A is missing. No untestable rule is reported as passed. Large investment gains make earnings a weak proxy for recurring cash generation. Minority interests and some missing balance-sheet items retain the calculator’s assumed-zero conventions and need review; the omitted preferred claim is explicitly restored.

steps.reason: The policy result is does_not_meet_rules. Quality is 3 of 5 and the required margin of safety is 40%. The operating valuation, uncertainty range and price-implied paths must be assessed separately from the conservative policy DCF. Business quality does not establish fair value. Market sentiment is not established from the filing snapshot. Weighted present value or a price/value gap must not be described as an expected annual return.

per_share_economics.definition: Historical flows use matching split-adjusted weighted-average diluted shares, not point-in-time shares outstanding. Observed diluted share changes include repurchases, issuance and dilution-accounting effects; they do not identify gross issuance separately.
per_share_economics.forecast_note: Forecast share paths are explicit analyst diagnostics; they do not reprice the existing enterprise DCF. Its current-share denominator and expensed SBC remain unchanged. Forecast EPS is an adjusted operating proxy when scenario margins exclude acquisition amortization. Missing bridge inputs make FCF/EPS unavailable.
